submit.title: Share a safety record.
submit.subtitle: Add the client details and attach the document. Please review carefully—public submissions cannot be edited after they are sent.

submit.publicDataNotice: By continuing, you confirm these details may be published in the public directory.

submit.step2Subheading: Choose the category and attach one supporting file.

submit.fileHint: PDF, DOC, or DOCX · Maximum 4 MB (large PDFs are compressed automatically)

submit.beforeSubmitText: make sure the document is suitable for public viewing and does not contain confidential or sensitive personal information.

submissionErrors.noFile: Please choose a document before submitting.
submissionErrors.MISSING_FIELDS: Please complete every required field and attach a document.
submissionErrors.INVALID_FILE_TYPE: Only PDF, DOC, and DOCX files are allowed.
submissionErrors.FILE_SIZE: Your document must be between 1 byte and 4 MB.
submissionErrors.FILE_TOO_LARGE_AFTER_COMPRESSION: This PDF is still too large after compression. Try a document with fewer pages or a lower scan quality.
submissionErrors.FILE_TYPE_CANNOT_COMPRESS: This file is over 4 MB and DOC/DOCX files can't be compressed automatically. Please reduce the file size or convert it to PDF.
submissionErrors.CLIENT_SAVE_ERROR: We could not save the client record. Please try again.
submissionErrors.DOCUMENT_REQUIRED_FOR_EXISTING_CLIENT: Attach a document when adding another report to an existing client.
submissionErrors.TOO_MANY_CONTACTS: You can add up to 4 extra names, telephone numbers, or email addresses each.
submissionErrors.UPLOAD_ERROR: We could not upload the document. Please try again.

submissionErrors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many submissions from your network recently. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
